max_tokens.description: Completion-token cap for the run; uncapped when absent.

model.description: Model identifier for the run; blackwall defaults when absent.

project.description: The blackwall project the run executes under (`"soma"`).

prompt.description:
The prompt to run. blackwall-serve requires either this (non-empty)
or `task`; with both set, `task` wins (blackwall's own precedence).
Empty is omitted from the wire — blackwall's field is optional and a
task-resolved dispatch has no inline prompt — matching
[`crate::payload::CustodyPayload::prompt`], so the direct and the
queued path serialize the same dispatch (EST-209).

provider.description: Provider hint (`"gateway"`); blackwall defaults when absent.

task.description:
A named task (`tasks/<name>/prompt.md` in the executing repo) to
resolve the prompt from instead of `prompt` (EST-209).
